Relive Sidhu Moose Wala’s Bad , now in stunning 8K. Sidhu Moose Wala wrote, composed and sang it, Dev Ocean made the music, and it’s pure, unfiltered Sidhu attitude, a classic his fans still play on repeat.
Every frame is sharper than ever, so you can relive the legend’s energy like never before
